---
title: "The data"
---

The example uses four CSV files from CoralNet.

| file | rows | what it is |
|---|---:|---|
| `metadata.csv` | 59 | one row per photo |
| `annotations.csv` | 5,900 | one row per point |
| `labelset.csv` | 15 | the CoralNet label list |
| `percent_covers.csv` | 59 | CoralNet's own cover summary |

The scripts read only `metadata.csv` and `annotations.csv`.
The other two files are useful for checking the result.

## The photos

Each row in `metadata.csv` has:

- the image name
- the date
- the latitude and longitude
- the camera height
- the camera name (the short name `TG-7`)
- the field group

All 59 photos are from one survey.
The date is 2026-10-20.
The place is Forte do Negrito, Terceira, Azores, Portugal.
The habitat is rocky intertidal, midtide level.

The camera is the **OM System Tough TG-7**.
The `Camera` column uses the short name `TG-7`.
The scripts write the full camera name in the event remarks.

The GPS positions come from the GPS built into the OM System Tough TG-7 camera.
Photo events use a position uncertainty of 1 metre.
The parent event uses 100 metres because it is a centre point for the survey.

## The points

Each row in `annotations.csv` is one point in one photo.
Each photo has 100 points.
The file has 5,900 rows.

The important columns are:

| column | meaning |
|---|---|
| `Name` | the image name |
| `Label code` | the short CoralNet label |
| `Label ID` | the CoralNet label number |
| `Annotator` | the CoralNet username |

The annotator can be a person or `robot`.
`robot` means the automated classifier.

## The labels

Six labels become occurrences.

| CoralNet label | Darwin Core name | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `CHLOROPHY` | Chlorophyta | green algae, phylum |
| `CIRRIPE` | *Chthamalus stellatus* | barnacle, species |
| `CORALLINA` | Corallinaceae | coralline red algae, family |
| `RHODO` | Rhodophyta | red algae, phylum |
| `RVL` | *Rivularia* | cyanobacterium, genus |
| `ULVA` | *Ulva* | green algae, genus |

These labels are left out:

| label | why |
|---|---|
| `SC` | substrate, not a taxon |
| `Unc` | unclear, not a taxon |
| `MAF` | filamentous macroalgae, deferred |
| `MAEN` | encrusting macroalgae, deferred |

::: {.callout-important}
`CIRRIPE` is a generic barnacle label.
It is mapped to *Chthamalus stellatus* because that is the barnacle in these photos.
Please review this mapping.

`RVL` has one point in one photo.
Please review this record before publishing.
:::

## The names

`recordedBy` is free text at the top of the script.
It is not read from the CSV files.

`identifiedBy` lists the CoralNet usernames for human annotations.
The CoralNet `robot` value is written as `CoralNet machine learning annotator`.
A mixed row can have more than one name, separated by `; `.

## The taxonomy

Each taxon in the script has a WoRMS AphiaID.
The occurrence ID ends with that number.
For example:

```text
MBON-P2P:20261020:PRT:TER:FDN:MIDTIDE:T1:IMG0128:aphia-144296
```

The last part, `aphia-144296`, is *Ulva*.

The taxonomy is written in the script.
A new survey may need new names and new AphiaIDs.
